derivation.onset: The record reports no ICANS and the documents hold no qualifying finding. Section 7.9(b): 7.7 when the window has at least one formal Grade 0 assessment (ICE 10/10, alert; section 3.3), no qualifying finding and no documented 'not assessable' period. All three hold.
derivation.max_grade: Same rule (section 7.9(b), A21): both fields are 7.7 together; the documented grade is 0 (every ICE 10/10, no domain finding).

ambiguity_notes: A mild headache on Day +3 is an excluded symptom (section 4.2), so it neither blocks 7.7 nor appears in the ungradeable-symptom flag. CRS fever and norepinephrine are not neurological findings. Coverage is not daily (no assessment on Days 0 and 6 documented), which is the open stricter-coverage question in 7.9(b) and does not change the answer under the current rule.
